overview: InputSearch is a specialized text input for search interactions. It renders a search icon when the field is empty and automatically replaces it with a clear (X) icon once the user begins typing, allowing one-click clearing of the query. It is built on top of InputText and accepts the same props.

whenToUse: Use InputSearch whenever a field is dedicated to filtering or querying a data set
Use it in page headers, toolbars, or sidebars where a search affordance is expected
do: Wrap InputSearch in an InputRow or label to provide an accessible label and error messaging
Provide a meaningful placeholder that describes what users can search for
dont: Don't use InputSearch for non-search inputs, use InputText for free-form text entry
